title: Service Test 3: Evaporator fan & air baffle

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)
source.oemTestTitle: Evaporator Fan and Air Baffle Motors

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 03
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 03. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 03 — Evaporator fan and air baffle

steps.title: Run test 3
steps.body: Test turns on FC evaporator fan and air baffle motor. Monitor air baffle feedback with SW3.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Test turns on FC evaporator fan and air baffle motor. Monitor air baffle feedback with SW3.

steps.title: Air baffle open
steps.body: Press SW3 until display shows 01 (fan on, air baffle open). Does damper open and fan run (2800 RPM spec)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW3 until display shows 01 (fan on, air baffle open). Does damper open and fan run (2800 RPM spec)?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Check evaporator fan motor, damper motor, or harness.

steps.title: Air baffle closed
steps.body: Press SW3 until display shows 02 (fan on, air baffle closed). Does damper close?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW3 until display shows 02 (fan on, air baffle closed). Does damper close?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace air baffle/damper motor or repair feedback circuit.

steps.title: Evap fan or damper fault
steps.oemOutcome: FC evaporator fan or air baffle failed to open in service test 3.

steps.title: Damper fault
steps.oemOutcome: Air baffle did not close or feedback incorrect in service test 3.

steps.title: Evap fan and damper verified
steps.oemOutcome: Service test 3 confirms evaporator fan and air baffle operation.
